title: Server administration
intro: Settings of this Ronde server, shared by all its workspaces. Each workspace's own settings (members, roles, security) are in its Settings. Values saved here win over the environment variables.
defaultLocaleHint: For people who have not picked a language in their account and whose browser offers none Ronde speaks.

invite-only.label: On invitation
invite-only.hint: Only people invited to a workspace.

domains.label: Email domains
domains.hint: Invited people, and anyone with an address of the domains below.

license.title: License
license.pureCommunity: This build is the pure Community edition: the paid editions' code is not included.

reasons.format: The saved key cannot be read.
reasons.payload: The saved key cannot be read.
reasons.signature: The saved key was changed or not issued by Ronde.
reasons.unknownKey: The saved key was signed by a key this version does not know.

license.graceUntil: Everything keeps working until {date}: renew the license before then.
license.readOnly: Paid features are read-only: what they hold stays readable, nothing new can be added. Community features are not affected.
license.seatsRule: people who took part in a meeting in the last 30 days
license.peak: Highest count of this license: {count} ({date}), the one the renewal counts.
license.overSeats: More people take part than the license's {seats} seats: nothing is blocked. The highest count is settled when the license is renewed.
license.overPeak: This license's highest count, {count}, went above its {seats} seats: nothing is blocked, it is settled when the license is renewed.
license.fromEnv: The key comes from the RONDE_LICENSE variable: change it there.
license.keyHint: Checked on this server, offline: nothing is sent anywhere.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: What people send with the “Send feedback” button. Answer them and mark what was dealt with; a problem with Ronde itself can go to the Ronde project as a GitHub issue. Messages are deleted after a year.
feedback.empty: No message yet. People send them with the button at the top of the pages.
feedback.toGithubHint: Opens a pre-filled issue on the Ronde project: names and workspaces are left out, and you can edit it before posting it.
